# openfluids

> An open, collaborative workshop for fluid flows, with ultra-modern code.

## Solvers

- [dolfinx-rans](https://github.com/openfluids/dolfinx-rans): RANS k-omega and k-omega SST turbulence solver for incompressible flow in DOLFINx, validated on turbulent channel flow

## Stability

- [linstabpy](https://github.com/openfluids/linstabpy): Sparse linear stability and resolvent analysis of 2D compressible flows
- [nekStab](https://github.com/nekStab/nekStab): Stability, bifurcation and sensitivity analysis for Nek5000

## Optimisation

- [organa](https://github.com/openfluids/organa): Adjoint topology optimisation for conjugate heat transfer, in parallel with MPI

## Analysis

- [openmodalpy](https://github.com/openfluids/openmodalpy): Modal decompositions (POD, DMD, SPOD and more) in one Python workflow
- [dsgbr](https://github.com/openfluids/dsgbr): Peak detection for noisy, sloped power spectra, benchmarked against SciPy
- [fftkit](https://github.com/openfluids/fftkit): One FFT API over many backends, with correctness checks and benchmarks
- [dynachaos](https://github.com/openfluids/dynachaos): Dynamical-systems analysis of time signals: Lyapunov exponents, recurrence, entropy and coupled-map lattices, with Rust-accelerated kernels
- [chaos-atlas](https://openfluids.github.io/chaos-atlas/): Interactive explorer for chaotic systems: strange attractors, bifurcations, fractals and coupled-map-lattice patterns, in the browser

## Runs and frames

- [hpckit](https://github.com/openfluids/hpckit): HPC work over SSH and Slurm: run packets, receipts, artifact sync
- [quadros](https://github.com/openfluids/quadros): CFD snapshots rendered into checked frames and videos

## On the bench

More is taking shape in the workshop: new solvers, GPU kernels and tools for studying how flows behave. They will open as they mature.
